name: refactor-discovery
description: Research methodology to surface non-obvious structural smell leads before promoting refactor candidates. Discovers project areas, investigates in parallel when available, synthesizes cross-cutting tensions, and produces a prioritized discovery document.

interface.shortDescription: Surface structural smell leads before planning refactors
interface.longDescription: Investigate codebases with structural discovery lenses, preserve uncertainty as smell leads or research tasks, and promote only mature findings into refactor candidates.
defaultPrompt: Find non-obvious refactor smells in this codebase
Run refactor discovery on a specific module
Investigate structural smells around an error handling flow
